decisions.reason: As a newly launched compact site machine still being actively marketed, it is likely to be kept while the firm builds sales and dealer acceptance.
An articulated construction dumper fits well with a German machinery maker’s core construction equipment portfolio and would normally be given more than one year to establish itself.

The underground mine rescue vehicle is a much narrower specialist product with potentially limited demand, but after a recent launch the firm would still usually retain it unless orders were clearly disappointing.
A compact telescopic loader is a logical adjacent product in compact machinery, so management would most likely continue offering it while developing the range and customer base.
